page.title: Outreach
page.description: STEM days, industry nights, Clubsfest, Facultyfest, Launch Canada youth outreach and a sponsor dinner from the McMaster Rocketry Team.
headline: See us on
campus.
page.lede: STEM days, industry nights, Clubsfest, Facultyfest, youth outreach at Launch Canada, and a dinner a sponsor put on for the team. Gold sponsors can put their name on the day.

sponsorPitch.headline: Put your name on the day.
body: Isaac Operations already did it, with a dinner for the team. Your name in front of students on campus, not only on an airframe at a competition most of them never see.
Want to fund one event instead of a season tier? Email us to get in touch.

events.name: Youth outreach at Launch Canada
events.blurb: On conference days at Launch Canada 2026. Kids filled in a rocketry bingo. Prizes were candy rockets. The grand prize was a McMaster Rocketry bucket hat.
events.photoAlt: A McMaster Rocketry bucket hat beside a stack of rocketry bingo cards on a table at Launch Canada 2026.
